scope.pooling: Do not pool the earlier 22-run matrix or three-run pilot; no improvement claim.
scope.model: 559,104 parameters; global batch 256; ETP=1; the matrix contains Attention-DP and Expert-DP views; no attention computation workload.
scope.fault: Host-delay proxy only; no DVFS or GPU clock manipulation.
scope.interpretation: Online rank hits describe terminal predictions. They are not paper-level acceptance or strict accuracy; report complete acceptance separately.

metric_policy.online_descriptive: Uses online_predictions_union from every fixed row without filtering by valid; TP/FP/FN count distinct predicted ranks per row, and pending/unrun rows remain in planned denominators.
metric_policy.singleton_correct: Descriptive-only positive row with exactly the target rank in its terminal prediction union; not strict accuracy and not paper-level acceptance.
metric_policy.prediction_clean_controls: Terminal control attempt with an observed terminal prediction union, no rank predictions, and no global.jsonl parse error; full profile validity is not required.
metric_policy.full_acceptance: Reported separately from online screening metrics, against the fixed 36/28/8 plan.
metric_policy.pending: Pending is determined only by attempt status started/unknown/missing (or no attempt marker); it is independent of observed predictions and actual_steps.
metric_policy.failed: Terminal non-success attempts, including engineering_failure, are listed and counted separately from pending rows.
metric_policy.partial_iterations: Rank iteration events from incomplete attempts are reported separately; only successful completed attempts with derived actual_steps contribute to training_rank_iterations.
